usedFor: Whenever something shifts on a monday.com board, Roma gets a personal task in the list you choose.

bestTemplate.name: “Item Column Value Changes” in monday.com, then “Create Item” in Roma
bestTemplate.why: A changed column often leaves someone a to-do, and “Create Item” adds a task, note or row to Roma.

watchOut: One monday.com item edited several times adds several Roma tasks, since each column update fires the trigger.
